items.title: Subtitle Placement
items.summary: This refined placement strategy ensures that subtitles are always present when needed, reducing cognitive friction and enhancing the wearer's trust in real-time understanding. It also minimizes distractions during high-confidence moments, allowing the wearer to focus more on conversation.
items.probe: Define one fixed subtitle position rule for V1: keep subtitles at the bottom center of the display.

choices.label: More Prominent
choices.description: Bias toward easier visibility over subtlety.

items.title: Confidence Display
items.summary: By providing a clear and concise reason for the confidence score, the wearer can better understand when to trust the subtitles and memory support. This clarity reduces cognitive load and increases overall system trust.
items.probe: Choose one confidence display format for V1: label only or label plus short reason.

choices.label: Label Only
choices.description: Keep certainty display minimal and fast to parse.

choices.label: Label + Reason
choices.description: Expose a short reason to improve trust.

items.title: Memory/Cache Policy
items.summary: Implementing this cache size limit will allow the system to maintain a balance between providing relevant memory support and conserving battery life. It ensures that the wearer can rely on recent interactions while not consuming excessive resources.
items.probe: Define a local cache size limit of 10 entries for frequently encountered faces and names.

choices.label: Smaller Cache
choices.description: Bias toward tighter local memory and lower load.

choices.label: Recency First
choices.description: Bias toward recent names and conversations.

items.title: Phone/Cloud Boundary
items.summary: This rule ensures that the most critical real-time functionality—live subtitles—is always as fast and reliable as possible, thereby reinforcing trust in the product's core mission of providing clear and timely assistance during conversations.
items.probe: Define one task-specific cloud fallback boundary for live subtitle processing: if latency exceeds 100ms, fall back to cloud; otherwise, process locally on the phone.

choices.label: Phone First
choices.description: Keep critical work local unless clearly necessary.

choices.label: Balanced Fallback
choices.description: Allow cloud assist for slower or richer lookups.

items.title: Visual Hierarchy
items.summary: By prioritizing subtitles, we ensure that the wearer remains focused on essential information without visual clutter, enhancing their ability to follow conversations and understand context, which aligns with our core attractors of real-time subtitle clarity and low-friction assistance.
items.probe: Define one visual priority rule between subtitles and one-line support in V1.

choices.label: Subtitles Dominate
choices.description: Keep subtitles above all other overlays.

choices.label: Balanced Overlay
choices.description: Allow prompts to share attention more evenly.
